name: Aceternity UI
licence: Free components: free for unlimited personal and commercial projects; reselling/redistributing as a competing library not permitted (ui.aceternity.com/llms-full.txt header; full terms ui.aceternity.com/licence, not read). Pro blocks/templates commercial.
bestFor: one-off concept heroes and portfolio pieces
learning scroll-linked 3D and parallax techniques (container scroll, macbook scroll, hero parallax)
avoidFor: trustworthy B2B SaaS marketing (lamp, spotlight, aurora, beams are the canonical AI-landing clichés)

typography.notes: 15 text effects (Flip Words, Typewriter, Text Generate, Encrypted Text, Colourful Text, Hero Highlight, Text Hover, Squiggly, Text Flipping Board...).

color.contrastNotes: Glow-on-black with gradient text; contrast not addressed.

radius.rule: Pills and large radii on CTA effects.

shadows: glow via blur-xl / blur-2xl / blur-3xl gradient blobs
depth.blur: heavy: blur-md to blur-3xl on decorative layers

motion.notes: TextGenerateEffect duration 0.5s with blur filter; Lamp delay 0.3 duration 0.8 easeInOut, width 8rem->16rem / 15rem->30rem whileInView; MovingBorder 3000ms per lap; SpotlightNew 7s loop; HoverBorderGradient 1s per step. No reduced-motion handling in the 6 sampled registry sources.

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Low: decorative; hover and in-view are the states.

tokenArchitecture: None; Tailwind classes and motion props inline per component.
distinctiveness: Very recognisable, therefore low as identity: the lamp, spotlight, background beams and aurora became shorthand for 'template AI startup'.
weaknesses: Strongest AI-cliché association of any library studied
Heavy blur layers and canvases cost performance
No reduced-motion handling in sampled sources
takeaways: Scroll-linked 3D reveal (container-scroll-animation) is a valid product-proof device when the screen shown proves a workflow; strip the glow.
